CRD title: Efficacy and Safety of Jujube(Ziziphus jujuba Mill) in Treatment of Type 2 Diabetes Mellitus: A Systematic Review and Meta-analysis.
Condition being studied: Diabetes mellitus is a chronic metabolic disease characterized by persistent hyperglycemia. With changing lifestyles, the number of people suffering from diabetes has increased in recent years， and diabetes has become a major global health problem. According to the 10th edition of the International Diabetes Federation（IDF）Diabetes Map 2021, 537 million adults aged 20-79 have diabetes, with a prevalence rate of 10.5%. Chinese medicine has good efficacy in the treatment of diabetes, and jujube is often found in Chinese herbal formulas because of its ability to benefit the Qi, nourish the blood, and moderate the medicinal properties. Usually, jujube is considered too sweet to be harmful to diabetic patients. However, some studies have found that jujube can lower blood sugar, improve glucose metabolism and regulate insulin-sensitive enzymes. There are currently no studies evaluating the efficacy and safety of jujube or prescription containing jujube in diabetes. Therefore, we conducted the first randomized controlled systematic evaluation and meta-analysis to assess the efficacy and safety of jujube in patients with type 2 diabetes.

CRD title: Efficacy of cassia cinnamon on hyperglycemia: A systematic review and meta-analysis
Condition being studied: Diabetes, group of metabolic disorders caused by defects in insulin production or function result in high blood sugar levels. As yet, there is no cure, people with diabetes need to manage their disease to stay healthy. Use of conventional hypoglycemic agent is a costly treatment and cause some of side effect too. On the other hand, cinnamon is an herbal product, with less price and minimal side effect. Some of in vitro study suggests Cinnamon as anti-diabetic agent which can lower blood sugar by imitating biological activity of insulin and increases movement of blood glucose into cells. Cinnamon has been studied in RCTs and comparative studies for its glucose lowering effects.
